entries.name: Void Swarmer
entries.description: A ravenous scrap of void that hurls itself at the nearest hull. Alone it is a nuisance; in a pack it chews through plating fast.

entries.name: Void Spitter
entries.description: Hangs back at the edge of weapons range and lobs slow globs of void. Patient, bloated, and easy to sidestep if you keep moving.

entries.name: Command Console
entries.description: The Gunner's post: tactical readouts, threat tracking and too many blinking lights. Every carrier has exactly one.

entries.name: Upgrade Bench
entries.description: Where the Engineer turns credits and Void Crystal into thicker plating, hotter guns and faster thrusters.

entries.name: Berth
entries.description: A docking cradle for one battleship. Board from here to launch into a mission.

entries.name: Sample Analyzer
entries.description: The Researcher's post. It hums along with every Void Crystal sample you bring home.

entries.name: Salvage Sorter
entries.description: Rattling conveyors that pick the good bits out of the wreckage, so every successful run pays a little more.

entries.name: Combat Simulator
entries.description: Endless practice sorties against simulated swarms. Pilots who train here fire their skills sooner.

entries.name: Bunk bed
entries.description: Two narrow bunks stacked against the wall. Nobody admits to snoring.

entries.name: Locker
entries.description: A dented steel locker for flight suits, spare socks and contraband snacks.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: A sturdy mess table, bolted down in case the gravity fails during dinner.

entries.name: Stool
entries.description: Somewhere to sit that is not the floor. Barely.

entries.name: Sofa
entries.description: A worn, comfortable sofa. The best seat on the carrier, and everyone knows it.

entries.name: Cat bed
entries.description: A round cushion the ship's cat ignores in favour of the console keyboard.

entries.name: Cat tree
entries.description: A carpeted tower with a lookout at the top, for supervising the crew.

entries.name: Scratching post
entries.description: Sacrificed so the sofa may live.

entries.name: Food and water bowls
entries.description: Two bowls that must never, ever be empty, according to the cat.

entries.name: Crate stack
entries.description: Supplies nobody has got round to unpacking. Probably bolts. Possibly snacks.

entries.name: Snack dispenser
entries.description: Takes credits, gives snacks, occasionally keeps both.

entries.name: Aquarium
entries.description: A glowing tank of hardy fish that have seen more of space than most pilots.

entries.name: Potted plant
entries.description: A little green to remind the crew what planets were like.

entries.name: Hydroponic planter
entries.description: A lit planter growing herbs and the odd tomato under grow lamps.

entries.name: Floor lamp
entries.description: Warm light for a cold ship.

entries.name: Rug
entries.description: A soft rug that makes a steel deck feel a little more like home.

entries.name: Wall screen (star map)
entries.description: A wall-mounted star map showing where you are, and how far there is still to go.

entries.name: Wall light
entries.description: A small sconce that keeps the corridors from feeling like a void.

entries.name: Tool rack
entries.description: Every wrench in its place. Until the Engineer needs one.

entries.name: Pilot
entries.description: The carrier's captain and battleship pilot. Flies every mission personally and walks the decks between them.

entries.name: Gunner
entries.description: Runs the Command Console and reads a swarm like a weather report. Blunt, steady, hard to impress.

entries.name: Researcher
entries.description: Keeps the Sample Analyzer humming and dreams of a proper lab. Finds Void Crystal far more exciting than is healthy.

entries.name: Engineer
entries.description: Lives at the Upgrade Bench. Bring credits and crystals and the ships come back faster, tougher and louder.

entries.name: Kite
entries.description: A fast, fragile interceptor. Afterburn darts it out of trouble and Scatter shreds anything that follows.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.description: A slow, heavily plated gunship. Bastion soaks the hits and Shockwave throws the swarm back.
